messages:
Kira Matsumoto: FYI ran into a broken anchor after merging the quickstart tidy PR — link-checker failed in CI with `Anchor not found: quickstart-setup` from /docs/index.html.
Kira Matsumoto: Log: ```Error: Anchor not found: quickstart-setup referenced from /docs/index.html at checkLinks (link-checker/index.js:82)```
Owen Blake: that anchor should be `quickstart-setup` normally. Did someone add inline code or an emoji in the heading?
Mira Shah: I did a tiny edit earlier: changed `## Quickstart - Setup` -> `## Quickstart - Setup (CLI)` and added inline code for the CLI example `pip install redwood`. Guess that changed the slug.
Kira Matsumoto: Sigh, classic. Two options: update every incoming link or pin a manual id on the heading like `{#quickstart-setup}`. Manual id is less risky for cross-doc references.
Owen Blake: Agreed. Also we keep hitting variants: NBSPs, emoji, slashes. We should add a pre-commit hook to warn if a heading contains punctuation/emoji/inline code without an explicit `{#id}`.
Mira Shah: I'll open a small PR to: 1) add `{#quickstart-setup}` to the heading, 2) run `rg "#quickstart-setup" -n docs` to update any broken links, 3) add a CI job that runs `npx markdown-link-check` after the build, and 4) add a pre-commit hook that runs a heading lint.
Owen Blake: nice plan. For the lint script, `scripts/ci/check-heading-ids.sh` can grep headings and fail when it finds `[:()\p{Emoji}\u00A0\`]+` without `{#`. We used a similar one in release notes.
Mira Shah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1128 — includes the heading id change, the link updates, `check-heading-ids.sh`, and docs workflow change to run `markdown-link-check` in PRs.
docs-bot: label added: docs-review. reviewers requested: Kira Matsumoto, Owen Blake.
Kira Matsumoto: Quick review: LGTM, but please add a short CONTRIBUTING blurb showing an example: `## Title with (weird chars) {#safe-id}`. New contributors keep hitting this.
Owen Blake: Also add a pre-commit hook entry in `scripts/pre-commit` that runs the same check locally and prints a helpful error message with a fix suggestion. We had contributors confused by the shell output before.
Mira Shah: Added CONTRIBUTING example and the `pre-commit` script. I added `precommit-bot` to auto-run the hook on PRs for a while.
ci-bot: running docs CI for PR 1128...
ci-bot: build succeeded, post-build markdown link-check passed, docs-lint-heading-ids passed.
docs-bot: PR #1128 merged by Mira Shah.
precommit-bot: pre-commit hooks added to repo. Contributors will get a warning if headings contain inline code/emoji without `{#id}`.
Kira Matsumoto: Verified on staging that `#quickstart-setup` resolves. Thanks Mira :tada:
Owen Blake: Filed follow-up issue to iterate on the linter to include NBSP normalization and detect encoded anchors like `%C2%A0`: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/241
Mira Shah: I'll pick the follow-up next sprint. Closing thread.
